name: Südzucker AG
summary: Südzucker AG produces and sells sugar products in Germany, Belgium, France, Austria, Poland, rest of Europe, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Sugar, Special Products, CropEnergies, Starch, and Fruit. The company offers sugar, specialty sugar products, and glucose syrup, as well as co products, such as animal feed; ingredients offering benefits comprising dietary fibers, sugar substitutes new sugars, rice starches, barley/rice flours, and vegetables texturates; and frozen and chilled pizza, frozen pasta dishes and snacks, baguette, breadsnacks, and portion packs.
